utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a little worried about the timing and who’s handling what, Gus. If we can pin down the route and the pickup plan, I’ll feel a lot better.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely, Pia — let’s nail it down. I can handle the pickup route and bring the tools, and we’ll make sure everyone knows their part.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps a lot, Gus. If you can send me the route and a simple schedule, I’ll keep everyone on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup and drop-off—what time is the repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Faye. It starts around 3, so your help with pickup would be a huge relief.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me—I can handle pickup and swing by after school. Just send me the exact address and any other details I should know.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — what do you need me to bring for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’m not sure yet — I only heard about it second-hand. If you know what’s needed, I can pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I don’t know the exact list either, but I can ask around and let you know. If you hear anything first, send it my way.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what still needs to be fixed?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Leo — we still need help with the loose fence panel and a couple of porch steps. If you’re free, I can point you to the spot.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m free now—point me to the loose fence panel first, and I’ll take a look at the porch steps after.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Rey—could you bring a hammer and some sturdy gloves? We’re still figuring out the rest, but that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure thing—I’ll bring a hammer and sturdy gloves. Let me know if you need anything else as the plan settles.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d like to double-check the details first—what items are we collecting for the repair drive, and when do we need them by?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re collecting basic repair supplies like screws, nails, tape, and a few hand tools. I’ll confirm the deadline and get it to you right away.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Cleo—please send the deadline when you confirm it, and I’ll keep the supply list to screws, nails, tape, and hand tools for now.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a bit scattered today, but I’m happy to help if you need me to bring anything or spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Oren — could you spread the word and bring any spare tools you’ve got? I’ll gather the rest and keep you posted.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and dig up whatever spare tools I can find. Just remind me again if I forget anything, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful, Mara—thank you. If you can bring gloves, a hammer, and help sort the donation table, we’ll be in great shape.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll bring gloves and a hammer, and I can help sort the donation table too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t got anything logged yet, but I can keep an eye on where the repair drive is set up. If you want, I can help track it down.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Opal — can you let me know where it ends up once you spot it?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll keep tracking it and let you know as soon as I spot where it ends up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Ira — I’ll let everyone know and keep the repair drive plan moving.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks. If I hear anything useful, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I might’ve missed the details, but I’m around if you need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — can you confirm when it’s happening and what you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m not totally sure on the timing — I think it’s this weekend, but I may have missed an update. If you can send me the final details, I’ll help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Eli — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Sam. Let’s start by listing the repairs, then I’ll sort them by priority and we can make a simple plan.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — send me the list, and I’ll help sort out the repairs with you.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like to keep it simple: tell me the time, the place, and what I should bring, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can do that — I just need to confirm the time and pickup spot first, then I’ll tell you exactly what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — just let me know when you’ve confirmed it, and I’ll go from there.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I just want to confirm the details before I say anything definite—what’s the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m just checking in for the latest too — I haven’t heard the final details yet. Tell me what you’ve got so far.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Mostly just a heads-up on what tools and parts you can spare, and when you can drop them off.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can check what I’ve got and swing by later today with whatever I can spare.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo — I’m putting the repair drive list together now. If you’ve got any houses or fixes to add, send them my way and I’ll log them.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rosa — please add 14 Maple for the loose front step and the broken porch light.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Got it — I’ve added 14 Maple for the loose front step and broken porch light. Thanks, Leo; send any more and I’ll keep the list updated.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Sam — could you help me sort the donated tools and check a few items for missing parts?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course — I can sort the donated tools and check them for missing parts. Just point me to the pile, and I’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m thinking we should spread the word fast—want me to invite a few folks for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, that would help a lot. Thanks, Quinn—keep it small and nearby if you can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll keep it small and just reach out to a few nearby neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of the repair drive locations if you want—just tell me where we’re starting and where we need to go.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, thanks. I’m just going off what I’ve heard, so I may need you to steer us.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely—just give me the first stop, and I’ll keep us on course from there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I was meaning to ask if you still need any help with it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I could still use a hand with it — I’m planning to sort through the donations and then list what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I can help sort through the donations if you want, and then we can make a quick list of what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m glad the repair drive is coming together—what still needs to be fixed?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I think a few things still need attention, but I might be missing some of the details. What’s left on your list?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ve got a few small things on my list, but I should double-check the details first. I can text you a quick rundown after I look it over.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is really getting moving now—looks like folks are pitching in. If you need the details, I can ask around and pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, that’d be great, Tess. If you hear what tools or supplies they still need, I can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Gus — I’ll ask around and let you know what they’re short on. Thanks for offering to help!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll double-check the details before I say yes—what exactly do you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We need volunteers, tools, and a couple of spare hours to help with the repairs. Can you let me know if you’re in?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m in, as long as we confirm what tools are needed and when you want me there.
